data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to create static and dynamic home screen shortcuts for Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides an API to define, update, and clear app shortcuts on the device home screen. It supports both static and dynamic shortcuts with optional icon assets.
use_when: You need quick access shortcuts for common actions
You want to add dynamic shortcuts that change at runtime
You target Android and iOS platforms
avoid_when: You need platform‑specific deep‑link handling beyond shortcuts
You require web or desktop shortcut support
strengths: Dynamic updates without restarting the app
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, run pub get, optionally call FlutterShortcut.initialize(debug:true) on Android
